text:
tomas: quick check-in about canonicalizing tenant identity at the edge. problem: cost attribution + sampling break when requests hop regions or hit different ingest paths. proposal: tiny prov-sidecar that emits a stable, pseudonymous tenant fingerprint + per-request id. keeps payload tiny and avoids shipping raw tenant identifiers downstream. @meenal @carter any blockers from privacy or perf?

meenal: :eyes: high level looks good. threat model ask: if fingerprint is reversible or collides, we leak tenant mapping. recommend keyed MAC (siphash) instead of plain hash, and a rotation + historic mapping retention plan so billing queries don't lose past attributions. also confirm no raw emails in any headers.

carter: perf thoughts: sidecar CPU + latency budget must be tiny. siphash64 with a region-local key is cheap (<200ns per call in our bench), KMS provides key material and we rotate. caching the derived fingerprint per-conn helps. ingest will need a small LRU cache map from fingerprint->tenant id for backfills; if miss, mark as "anon" and emit metric. will run microbench.

lina: rollout ops: we should gate by observability signals. propose canary 5% traffic, then 25%, then 100% with automated rollback if missing-provenance spikes or billing mismatch rate > 0.3%. dashboards: prov.lookup.miss_rate, prov.header.presence_pct, prov.sidecar.p99_latency. also add runbook steps for backfill job to reconcile pre-cutover traces.

obs-bot: RFC ref: https://redwoodinference.internal/rfcs/2026/prov-sidecar (branch: prov-sidecar-v1). perf CI job queued: perf/prov-sidecar.

tomas: sample header proto we want: ```
X-RW-PROV: sip64:<hex>   // keyed tenant fingerprint
X-RW-REQ: <uuid>         // request id for stitchability
```keep header <= 64 bytes; no tenant names, no emails.

meenal: rotation plan draft: per-region KMS-wrapped key, rotate daily-derived keys every 30d, retain mapping of old_fingerprint->tenant for 90d in a secure migration table accessible only to billing and privacy. legal ok pending privacy sign-off. also add HMAC of req-id if we later need integrity checks.

carter: action: i'll run perf harness (1000rps/10k conns) and post latency + CPU delta. i'll also add unit tests for collision checks and a synthetic ingest miss simulator to validate alerts.

lina: action: I'll add the three dashboards + alerts and the cutover playbook (gates + rollback). will include a query to surface distribution of "anon" attributions by region and service.

tomas: decision summary: proceed with edge sidecar emitting siphash64 fingerprint + req id. ingest will cache mapping; fallback = "anon" with metric. rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with observability gates. follow-ups: tomas updates RFC and playbook, carter = perf + tests, meenal = privacy + rotation table, lina = dashboards + runbook. thanks all :thumbsup:

carter: noted, starting perf runs now. will report results in-thread.

meenal: prepping privacy memo and will ping legal.

lina: creating dashboards and alerting rules, will link shortly.

obs-bot: created task RW-8432: "prov-sidecar rollout" assigned to tomas, carter, meenal, lina.
